# Faiza Nadeem , @thefaizaglam

> Beauty and makeup content creator based in Long Island, New York. Runs @thefaizaglam on Instagram, reaching 3.06 million unique viewers per month with makeup, skincare, and beauty content. Estée Lauder Community × Seen partner.

## Identity

- Full name: Faiza Nadeem
- Handle: @thefaizaglam (Instagram, TikTok, Threads)
- Location: Long Island, New York, United States
- Profession: Beauty and makeup content creator
- Category: Makeup, beauty, skincare content
- Heritage: Pakistani-American (Faiza wears the hijab personally; her page is a makeup and beauty page, not a hijab-focused page)
- Languages: English, Urdu

## Reach and audience

- 4.15 million monthly views on Instagram
- 3.06 million unique viewers per month
- 1,032× follower-to-reach ratio (discovery-algorithm creator)
- 98% of reach comes from non-followers
